boards.title: Your First Weekend at University at Buffalo, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A low-pressure first-weekend sequence that starts with wayfinding, moves through North Campus landmarks and ends with options for getting involved.

cards.title: Start with the Welcome Center
cards.subtitle: First floor, North Campus Student Union
cards.notes: Stop here first for directions and current event information, then use the building as your anchor while you learn the North Campus layout.
cards.short_summary: A practical first stop for campus directions and event information.
cards.evidence_claim: UB says the Welcome Center is on the first floor of the North Campus Student Union and staff provide event information and directions.
cards.access_notes: The Student Union building is listed as open 24/7; office services have separate weekday hours.

cards.title: Settle in with a board game
cards.subtitle: North Campus Student Union
cards.notes: Bring a new classmate or roommate, choose a game from the Welcome Center checkout collection, and use the room for a simple shared break.
cards.short_summary: A free Student Union space for low-key social time.
cards.evidence_claim: UB describes the Board Game Room as a student space with games available for checkout through the Welcome Center, with free access for UB students.
cards.access_notes: Free access is stated for UB students; game checkout is through the Welcome Center.

cards.title: Walk the edge of Lake LaSalle
cards.subtitle: North Campus recreational lake
cards.notes: Take a daylight loop by the water, pause to look for ducks or herons, and use the surrounding paths to orient yourself to campus landmarks.
cards.short_summary: A campus lake for an outdoor orientation walk.
cards.evidence_claim: UB identifies Lake LaSalle as a 60-acre man-made North Campus lake that attracts ducks, heron and geese.
cards.source_title: Baird Point/Lake LaSalle | University at Buffalo
cards.access_notes: Use daylight and follow posted campus guidance; the source describes fishing and sunbathing but does not state visitor fees.

cards.title: Find the columns at Baird Point
cards.subtitle: South shore of Lake LaSalle, North Campus
cards.notes: Use the outdoor amphitheater as a meeting landmark, look across Lake LaSalle, and save a photo from the columns before continuing your campus walk.
cards.short_summary: A recognizable lakeside amphitheater and campus landmark.
cards.evidence_claim: UB describes Baird Point as an outdoor Greek-style amphitheater on Lake LaSalle's southern shore and notes that it hosts bands for Springfest and Fallfest.
cards.source_title: Baird Point/Lake LaSalle | University at Buffalo
cards.access_notes: Outdoor landmark; check the campus events calendar for any scheduled use of the amphitheater.

cards.title: Make Lockwood your study waypoint
cards.subtitle: North Campus
cards.notes: Walk through the library, note the floors that fit your study style, and bookmark its research help before the first full week of classes.
cards.short_summary: UB's largest library, with collections and research support.
cards.evidence_claim: UB Libraries identifies Lockwood Memorial Library as the largest of UB's libraries and says it is located on North Campus.
cards.source_title: Lockwood Memorial Library | University at Buffalo Libraries
cards.access_notes: Consult the Libraries' current hours page before making a late visit.

cards.title: See Abbott Library on South Campus
cards.subtitle: South Campus
cards.notes: If you take the trip to South Campus, step inside Abbott to see its historic reading-room details and add it to your future quiet-study options.
cards.short_summary: A historic library stop on UB's South Campus.
cards.evidence_claim: UB's visitor guide highlights Abbott Library for its handcarved mantelpiece, antique chandeliers and custom woodwork.
cards.source_title: Top 10 Places To See at UB | University at Buffalo
cards.access_notes: Check current library access and hours before traveling to South Campus.

cards.title: Check the Center for the Arts calendar
cards.subtitle: North Campus
cards.notes: Walk through the CFA lobby, look for current performance notices, and choose a future program that fits your schedule rather than planning around assumptions.
cards.short_summary: A North Campus venue for multidisciplinary arts programming.
cards.evidence_claim: UB describes the Center for the Arts as a multidisciplinary arts venue where performances take place.
cards.source_title: Top 10 Places To See at UB | University at Buffalo
cards.access_notes: Individual performances may require tickets or have separate entry rules; consult the specific event listing.

cards.title: Look for the current CFA Gallery exhibition
cards.subtitle: 201 Center for the Arts, North Campus
cards.notes: Pair your CFA visit with a gallery walk, then read the exhibition information on site to decide whether to return for a related program.
cards.short_summary: A university gallery with year-round exhibitions and educational programs.
cards.evidence_claim: UB says its two art galleries present year-round exhibitions and educational programs; it lists UB CFA Gallery at 201 Center for the Arts.
cards.source_title: UB Art Galleries | University at Buffalo
cards.access_notes: UB lists gallery hours as Tuesday–Saturday, 11 a.m.–5 p.m.; verify exhibition dates before visiting.

cards.title: Meet at the Bronze Bison
cards.subtitle: In front of the Center for the Arts, North Campus
cards.notes: Use this sculpture as an easy photo and meeting point before heading to the CFA, especially if your group is splitting up around North Campus.
cards.short_summary: A named campus sculpture outside the Center for the Arts.
cards.evidence_claim: UB's visitor guide identifies the Bronze Bison in front of the Center for the Arts and says it was modeled after an original at Buffalo's Central Terminal.
cards.source_title: Top 10 Places To See at UB | University at Buffalo

cards.title: Locate Broadview Arena for future recreation
cards.subtitle: 175 Broadview Arena, North Campus
cards.notes: Walk over to identify the entrance and review available recreation options, then check the current schedule before returning for an activity or facility visit.
cards.short_summary: A centrally located North Campus recreation facility.
cards.evidence_claim: UB describes Broadview Arena as a North Campus multipurpose facility with courts, fitness areas, an indoor track and recreation spaces.
cards.access_notes: Access and activity hours vary; UB directs visitors to current schedules and notes that some recreation access requires membership.
